user.title: Diskpilot
user.description: Select your price source and optional meters. Name profiles here or add them later in the card. Import your own CSV/JSON files without an AI connection.

prices.title: Prices and contract
prices.description: Complete price lists are used unchanged. Nord Pool can be combined with Eltariff fixed energy rates (transfer and energy tax) within their validity dates. Scheduled/dynamic grid energy rates are not yet supported. Markup is per kWh including VAT and may be negative. The Nord Pool sensor must not contain charges added here. Without a grid source, only spot price and markup are shown.

data.price_attributes: Attributes containing future price lists (comma separated)
data.price_multiplier: Convert price to currency/kWh (1 for SEK/kWh, 0.01 for öre/kWh)
data.spot_includes_vat: Nord Pool sensor prices already include VAT

error.invalid_profiles: Enter up to 50 distinct profile names, 1–80 characters each, one per line.
error.invalid_spot: Select a spot-price-only Nord Pool sensor in the chosen currency/kWh.
error.invalid_source: Select an existing integration of the correct type.
error.invalid_area: The area must be configured in the selected Nord Pool integration.
